SELECT cos.id, cos.check_in_id as checkInId, cos.order_id as orderId, bo.order_no as orderNo, cos.room_id as roomId, r.room_number as roomNumber, rt.type_name as roomTypeName, cos.user_id as userId, u.username as username, ci.guest_name as guestName, cos.extra_fee as extraFee, cos.damage_fee as damageFee, cos.total_fee as totalFee, cos.deposit_refund as depositRefund, cos.payment_method as paymentMethod, e.real_name as operatorName, cos.create_time as createTime FROM check_out_settlement cos LEFT JOIN check_in_record ci ON cos.check_in_id = ci.id LEFT JOIN booking_order bo ON cos.order_id = bo.id LEFT JOIN room r ON cos.room_id = r.id LEFT JOIN room_type rt ON r.room_type_id = rt.id LEFT JOIN users u ON cos.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN employee e ON cos.operator_id = e.id
AND bo.order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{orderNo}, '%')
AND ci.guest_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{guestName}, '%')
AND cos.create_time >= DATE(#{startDate,jdbcType=DATE})
AND cos.create_time < DATE_ADD(DATE(#{endDate,jdbcType=DATE}), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
ORDER BY cos.create_time DESC

SELECT cos.id, cos.check_in_id as checkInId, cos.order_id as orderId, bo.order_no as orderNo, cos.room_id as roomId, r.room_number as roomNumber, rt.type_name as roomTypeName, cos.user_id as userId, u.username as username, ci.guest_name as guestName, cos.extra_fee as extraFee, cos.damage_fee as damageFee, cos.total_fee as totalFee, cos.deposit_refund as depositRefund, cos.payment_method as paymentMethod, e.real_name as operatorName, cos.create_time as createTime FROM check_out_settlement cos LEFT JOIN check_in_record ci ON cos.check_in_id = ci.id LEFT JOIN booking_order bo ON cos.order_id = bo.id LEFT JOIN room r ON cos.room_id = r.id LEFT JOIN room_type rt ON r.room_type_id = rt.id LEFT JOIN users u ON cos.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN employee e ON cos.operator_id = e.id WHERE cos.id = #{id}
